data.name: High Elevation
data.detailed_description:
Traverse a broken world forgotten by your corporate host, reconnecting a critical structure in a relaxing 3D platformer. Scale the company's space elevator to bring it back online, though be cautions destruction of your unit means redeploying at the very beginning. Use fluid parkour and climbing to navigate a stunning, atmospheric open world, creating your own path forward.

  • Fluid & Liberating Movement: Leap from high machinery, traverse open landscapes, and scale colossal structures with ease. The world is your playground and every surface is a potential path.

  • A Atmospheric Open World: Explore a stunning world where every biome tells a story. Landscapes and structures designed to inspire awe and a sense of peaceful solitude.

  • Relaxing, Meditative Gameplay: There is no rush, only a mission. High Elevation is an experience focused on the structures and landscape. The gentle ambience and the rhythmic satisfaction of movement create a therapeutic and immersive experience.
